title: MIDI clip / chords
description: Textual MIDI: writes notes as text in the song: chords, a melody, or a list of notes with their timing, over a number of bars. It needs no file and gives notes that an instrument can play.

parameters.name: ppq
parameters.doc: Ticks per quarter note for exact imported MIDI timing; the default uses decimal beats.

parameters.name: chords
parameters.placeholder: for example: Am F C G
parameters.doc: Chord names, one per bar, used to create a MIDI progression. A name is a root and a quality (Am, F, G7, Cmaj7, Dsus4, Bbm7); C/E puts E lowest (an inversion), and two chords joined by a dot (Am.F) share one bar.

parameters.name: melody
parameters.placeholder: for example: c4:1 d4:1 e4:2 r:1
parameters.doc: A melody instead of chords: note name, octave, length in beats and optionally the velocity from 1 to 127 (c4:1 is a quarter note, c4:1:60 the same, softer; r:2 a rest of two beats, # and b for sharps and flats). Without a velocity a note is struck at 96. Dynamics: a marker word pp, p, mp, mf, f or ff (32 to 112) sets the velocity of the notes after it, and < (crescendo) or > (decrescendo) ramps the notes after it to the next marker, for example: mp c4 d4 < e4 g4 ff c5:4. A note with its own velocity is not changed by a marker. Markers take no time. A note stops at the end of its bar.

parameters.name: notes
parameters.doc: Optional structured polyphonic notes: space-separated bar:beat:length:pitch:velocity entries, or a persistent notes { note { ... } } body with named fields and retained # comments. Beat and length are quarter-note beats with up to six decimal places, or exact integer ticks when ppq is set; each entry must fit inside its 4/4 bar. Longer notes use one entry per bar, joined by a shared ;tie=0..2000000 identity without forcing MIDI channel/bank/program. Routed nine-field entries and expanded tie-id fields remain supported.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.doc: Piano-roll scale guidance, as root:scale-id (for example c:major or f#:dorian), or none. It does not alter playback.

parameters.name: bars
parameters.doc: Length of the MIDI clip in bars.

parameters.name: bend
parameters.doc: A pitch bend curve over the clip, like the pitch wheel: auto(1:0, 2:100, 3:0) in percent of bend_range (100 is all the way up, -100 all the way down). The block that plays the notes bends its sound with it (every instrument). One note bends on its own with ;bend=<cents> on that note (;bend=200 glides two semitones up over the note).

parameters.name: bend_range
parameters.doc: How many semitones the bend curve reaches at 100 percent: 2 (the usual pitch wheel, the default when empty), 7, 12 (an octave) or 24.
